lines.text: God tells Moses to bring Aaron and his four sons to serve as priests, with holy garments made by skilled craftsmen.
Two onyx stones engraved with the names of the sons of Israel are fastened on the ephod's shoulder pieces as a memorial.
The breastpiece is square, with three rows of gemstones, and each of the twelve stones is engraved with a tribe's name.
Aaron carries the names of the sons of Israel and the Urim and Thummim on his forehead before the LORD.
A pure gold plate engraved HOLY TO THE LORD is fastened with a blue cord to the front of Aaron's turban.
